long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Istanbul in 1957, Aysal studied in England and Switzerland before entering tourism through the Kimeros resort in Antalya. At Ma Biche, she incorporated a thalassotherapy center and served as general manager. That experience led to a vice-presidency at Unit Tourism and Investment.

Aysal's defining project was the revival of a historic Bosphorus mansion as Hotel Les Ottomans. She personally oversaw its design and construction, blending Ottoman references with contemporary spa and hospitality ideas. The small all-suite hotel opened in 2006 and accumulated international boutique-hotel awards. Her record rests on hands-on development and operations, although the projects were built within a well-funded family corporate platform.
